queries.name: SourceType
queries.description: Where the tables load from: CSV (the files in DataFolder) or PostgreSQL (the core schema of the warehouse).

queries.name: DataFolder
queries.description: Folder that holds the CSV files exported by the SQL pipeline (data/processed). Used when SourceType is CSV.

queries.name: PostgreSQLServer
queries.description: PostgreSQL server, optionally with a port, for example localhost or localhost:5432. Used when SourceType is PostgreSQL.

queries.name: PostgreSQLDatabase
queries.description: PostgreSQL database created by the SQL pipeline. Used when SourceType is PostgreSQL.

queries.name: fnLoadTable
queries.description: Loads one table from the CSV folder or from PostgreSQL (core schema), keeps the listed columns and turns true/false columns into Yes/No.
text: (tableName as text, columns as list, optional yesNoColumns as list) as table =>
// One loader for every table, so switching between the CSV export and the PostgreSQL warehouse is a single parameter
Source = if SourceType = "PostgreSQL" then FromPostgreSQL() else FromCsv(),
// true/false (PostgreSQL) and t/f (CSV) both become Yes/No
if value = true or value = "t" or value = "true" then "Yes"
else if value = false or value = "f" or value = "false" then "No"
List.Transform(if yesNoColumns = null then {} else yesNoColumns, (name) => {name, ToYesNo, type text})
